title: Field monitor records how long each widget refresh takes
summary: For the site owner: every home-screen widget refresh now records how long the server took to answer, and the Recently resolved list is read faster, to track down "Could not refresh" on the widget.
items: Field monitor's Widget synchronization log lists each refresh's server time, marked when it passes the widget's 4-second limit. Time spent on the phone's network is not included.
Recently resolved reads the starts of earlier problems together instead of one at a time, with the same results.
Every widget route still requires the owner role on the server.
